title: Stripe Payment Gateway Integration
description: Integrate Stripe Checkout and Payment Elements to allow clients to pay invoices directly online with instant receipt generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Invoices have a 'Pay with Card' link that opens Stripe Checkout
Supports card payments, Apple Pay, and Google Pay
PaymentIntent amount matches invoice balance exactly

steps.details: Install `@stripe/stripe-js` and initialize Stripe client using STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.
Create API route to generate Stripe Checkout Sessions for given invoice IDs.
